items.hallucinated_text: Overall, there was a poor knowledge of the side effects of ACE-I. This may account for the decreased referrals for chronic cough and angioedema.
items.rationale: The evidence states referrals for these side effects have become more and more frequent and the clean text says increased referrals. Flipping 'increased' to 'decreased' reverses the stated relation/direction, contradicting the evidence.

items.hallucinated_text: The short- and long-term outcomes after LRT and SLT did not differ significantly. To avoid the risk for the donor in LRT, SLT represents the first-line therapy in adult liver transplantation in countries where cadaveric organs are available. LRT provides a solution for urgent cases in which a cadaveric graft cannot be found in time or if the choice of the optimal time point for transplantation is vital.
items.rationale: The study concerns pediatric liver transplantation (the question and evidence focus on children). Substituting 'pediatric' with 'adult' is a plausible but wrong entity (patient population) substitution unsupported by the evidence.

items.hallucinated_text: No single data source is likely to provide a complete health profile for an individual. For women with depression in pregnancy and dispensed antidepressants, the hospital admission data do not adequately capture all cases, missing approximately 35% of treated women.
items.rationale: The evidence and clean text never quantify the proportion of cases missed by hospital admission data; the only figure given is that around 10% of pregnant women suffer from depression. Inserting a fabricated 35% miss-rate is an unsupported invented claim.

items.hallucinated_text: There was increased expression of TGF-尾1 and VEGF in polyps compared to adjacent normal endometrial tissue. It suggested that these cytokines might play a role in endometrial polyp formation through enhanced apoptosis of glandular epithelial cells. In addition, there was a significant correlation between steroid receptor expression and VEGF and TGF-尾1 expression.
items.error_span: through enhanced apoptosis of glandular epithelial cells
items.rationale: The evidence attributes the role of VEGF to angiogenesis (thick-walled vessels) and TGF-尾1 to fibrotic tissue, not to apoptosis of glandular epithelium. The inserted mechanism clause is a plausible-sounding but wrong pathway not supported by the evidence.

items.hallucinated_text: There is a significant difference in sensitivity and specificity between four-view and two-view studies. Although oblique views have long been considered standard practice by some, our data could not identify a diagnostic benefit that might outweigh the additional cost and radiation exposure.
items.rationale: The evidence/clean text state there is no difference in sensitivity and specificity between four-view and two-view studies. Flipping 'no difference' to 'a significant difference' reverses the stated relation, contradicting the finding.

items.hallucinated_text: In our cohort, selective screening of patients aged>70 years, with carotid bruit, a history of cerebrovascular disease, diabetes mellitus or PVD would have reduced the screening load by 65%, with trivial impact on surgical management or neurological outcomes.
items.rationale: The clean text states the selective screening would have reduced the screening load by 40%. Substituting the number with 65% is a plausible but wrong numeric entity unsupported by the data.

items.hallucinated_text: Despite high perioperative mortality, results document a sustainable recovery of the survivors offering the prospect of a highly independent and satisfying life, with 90% returning to living at home independently. Therefore, advanced age alone should not be a contraindication for redo cardiac interventions. Geriatr Gerontol Int 2016; 16: 1138-1144.
items.error_span: with 90% returning to living at home independently
items.rationale: No such figure for the proportion returning to independent home living appears in the evidence (which reports a Barthel Index of 89 but no 90% home-return statistic). The inserted quantified claim is fabricated and unsupported.

items.hallucinated_text: Higher MCVs and AST/ALT ratios in ASH reflect direct ethanol-induced bone marrow suppression and do not differentiate NASH from ASH. Instead, these biomarkers might prove useful in guiding selection of patients for liver biopsy and in targeting therapy.
items.rationale: The clean text attributes higher MCVs and AST/ALT ratios to the severity of underlying liver disease, not to ethanol-induced bone marrow suppression. The substituted mechanism is plausible-sounding but wrong and unsupported by the evidence.

items.hallucinated_text: In summary, we report an overall improvement and high technical success rate for peripherial PTA. The use of hydrophilic guidewires made no significant difference to the technical success rate of PTA, especially in occlusion and more complicated lesions.
items.rationale: The clean text and the large success-rate improvements in the evidence (e.g., 60% to 96% for iliac occlusions) indicate hydrophilic guidewires made a significant difference. Inserting 'no' flips the relation to the opposite, contradicting the data.

items.hallucinated_text: The discrepancy in how Francophones view their physical health and their rates of diagnosed mental disorders may be related to health seeking behaviours in the Francophone population. Community and government agencies should try to improve the mental health of this population through mental health promotion and by addressing language and cultural barriers to health services.
items.rationale: The evidence and study concern Francophones' views of their mental health versus diagnosed mental disorders. Substituting 'mental health' with 'physical health' is a plausible but wrong entity substitution not supported by the evidence.

items.hallucinated_text: The use of the modified lithotomy position during pelvic surgery is not associated with lower limb ischemia. Addition of Trendelenburg position, however, causes profound ischemia of the lower limbs, and this is followed during the recovery period by hyperperfusion that is confined to the muscle compartments, which may put patients at risk of developing lower limb compartment syndrome, particularly when surgery exceeds four hours.
items.error_span: particularly when surgery exceeds four hours
items.rationale: The evidence describes prolonged elevation generally but never specifies a four-hour threshold for compartment syndrome risk. Inserting this specific time cutoff is a fabricated, unsupported claim.

items.hallucinated_text: We report for the first time ESLD etiology as a prognostic factor for survival. The renal function (expressed as serum creatinine) and urinary Na (<5 mEq/l) at the time of diagnosis were found to be associated with survival, suggesting that reversal of underlying portal hypertension might increase survival.
items.rationale: The clean text concludes that early treatment might increase survival, not reversal of portal hypertension. The evidence does not attribute improved survival to portal hypertension reversal; this substituted mechanism is plausible-sounding but wrong/unsupported.

items.hallucinated_text: Our data suggest that UHR intake criteria predict transition over 6 months in the order of Trait alone<APS<BLIPS. The fact that BLIPS patients are at the lowest risk of transition over the short term is consistent with the "early" versus "late" prodrome model. It also indicates that particular clinical attention may need to be paid to BLIPS patients, especially early in the course of treatment.
items.rationale: The evidence and clean text state BLIPS patients are at the highest risk of transition (order Trait<APS<BLIPS). Flipping 'highest' to 'lowest' reverses the risk relation, contradicting the ordering finding.

items.hallucinated_text: No evidence was found for OPLL to have any effect on the initial neurologic status or recovery in motor function after traumatic thoracic cord injury, suggesting that the neurologic outcome is not significantly dependent on canal space.
items.rationale: The study concerns cervical (C3-C4 level) spinal cord injury. Substituting 'cervical' with 'thoracic' is a plausible but wrong anatomical site substitution unsupported by the evidence.

items.hallucinated_text: Although most players in the study believe that rugby headgear may prevent concussion, only a minority reported wearing it, and those who did wore it on average for two seasons. Coaches tended to be less convinced than the players that rugby headgear can prevent concussion.
items.error_span: and those who did wore it on average for two seasons
items.rationale: The evidence reports attitudes and headgear-wearing rates but contains no data on the duration (number of seasons) headgear was worn. The inserted claim is a fabricated, unsupported finding.

items.hallucinated_text: Significant postoperative pain can be expected in the following situations: pain after prior surgery, presence of chronic pain sustained for more than six months due to peripheral nerve demyelination, intense preoperative pain, state of depression.
items.rationale: The evidence attributes postoperative pain memory to central sensitization of nociception neurons, not peripheral nerve demyelination. The inserted mechanism clause is plausible-sounding but wrong and unsupported by the evidence.

items.hallucinated_text: Older people with a history of amblyopia who develop visual loss in the previously normal eye can experience recovery of visual function in the amblyopic eye over a period of time. This recovery in visual function occurs prior to visual loss in the fellow eye and the improvement appears to be sustained.
items.error_span: occurs prior to visual loss in the fellow eye
items.rationale: The evidence and clean text state the recovery occurs in the wake of (after) visual loss in the fellow eye. Changing 'in the wake of' to 'prior to' reverses the temporal/directional relation, contradicting the evidence.

items.hallucinated_text: Patients in regional and rural settings were willing partners in developing skills of junior medical students, who had greater involvement in patient consultations than previously reported for urban students. Our study extends the findings from urban general practice that patients are underutilised partners in community-based nursing training. The support of patients from regional and rural settings could facilitate the expansion of primary care-based medical education in these areas of workforce need.
items.rationale: The study concerns community-based medical education and medical students. Substituting 'medical training' with 'nursing training' is a plausible but wrong entity substitution unsupported by the evidence.

items.hallucinated_text: In this series, the endoaortic occlusion was frequently ineffective, requiring conversion to cross-clamp in over half of cases, and was associated with a significantly higher risk of in-hospital death and a numerically higher risk of stroke.
items.error_span: requiring conversion to cross-clamp in over half of cases
items.rationale: The evidence reports the endoaortic balloon had to be replaced by the cross-clamp in only 10 of 52 patients (19.2%), not over half. The inserted quantitative claim is fabricated and contradicts the evidence.

items.hallucinated_text: The researchers studied a defined skin care protocol using a cleanser with aloe vera and a cleansing lotion, followed by application of either a moisture barrier with silicone or skin protectant with zinc oxide and menthol, undertaken at two different frequencies. Data revealed the incidence of moderate IAD was decreased in the experimental group by enhancing transepidermal water loss to keep the skin dry (receiving the skin protocol every 6 hours and p.r.n.).
items.error_span: by enhancing transepidermal water loss to keep the skin dry
items.rationale: The skin protectant/barrier and moisturizer work by maintaining the skin barrier and protecting against moisture, not by enhancing transepidermal water loss (which reflects barrier impairment). The inserted mechanism is plausible-sounding but physiologically wrong and unsupported by the evidence.
